title: Dynamic Analysis of a Demountable Grandstand
content: An experiment focused on human-induced vibration monitoring was carried out on the structure of a demountable temporary grandstand for spectators at the Biathlon World Championship in Nové Město na Moravě, Czech Republic. Before the races, a modal analysis was carried out to improve the FE model of the grandstand. The spectators’ behavior was recorded on camera during the races and was statistically evaluated. The vibration of the demountable grandstand was measured during the races too and synchronized with the camera records. The activity of the spectators, the maximal accelerations and the RMS values of the grandstand vibration were evaluated and discussed at the end of the article.
